schema.description: Program; a client run for several needs it, else its rows mix
schema.title: Program Code

schema.description: The base year the reader chose
schema.title: Base Year

schema.description: Narrow the near-threshold cohort to employees at or above this many weekly hours. An ABSOLUTE figure: the caller subtracts the band it wants from the statutory minimum this endpoint already returns in `thresholds`, so no jurisdiction's floor is baked into the query.
schema.title: Near Min Hours

schema.description: Narrow the counted cohort, as `col:expr;col:expr`. Compiled into SQL against a whitelist, so 10,236 employees are never fetched to be discarded in Python. Terms that do not parse are dropped and reported back in `filters_applied` rather than silently matching everything.
schema.title: Filter

schema.description: The same grammar over the near-threshold cohort. SEPARATE from `filter` because the two are different questions about different populations: one narrowing must not move the other's count under a tab nobody is looking at.
schema.title: Near Filter
